heroHeadline: CDC Ends Weekly Cyclospora Updates at 19,883 Cases as 7,000 Illnesses Remain Unattributed
heroSubtitle: CDC's Cyclospora case-data page, refreshed Sept 15, shows 19,883 lab-confirmed cases, 1,064 hospitalizations, and 2 deaths across 49 states and DC — the agency's last scheduled weekly update before moving to periodic reporting as new infections decline. Roughly 7,000 confirmed illnesses this season remain attributed to no identified source, down from 8,137 the prior week, and FDA's onsite inspection samples from Taylor Farms de México's Guanajuato facility remain unread. Separately, marking the Leafy Greens Marketing Agreement's 20th anniversary, food-safety attorney Bill Marler notes the industry program has made no public statement on the outbreak since Aug 9 even though Taylor Farms holds seats on its governing board.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
